source: In the paper’s A100 experiments, these changes produced roughly a ZXMATH0000XZ speedup over ZXNAME0000XZ-1 and reached 50–73% of theoretical maximum FLOPs/s, while end-to-end GPT-style training reached up to 225 TFLOPs/s per A100 under the reported setup.[5]
zh: 在本文的 A100 实验中，这些变化比 ZXNAME0000XZ-1 产生了大约 ZXMATH0000XZ 的加速，并达到理论最大 FLOPs/s 的 50-73%，而在报告的设置下，端到端 GPT 式训练达到每 A100 225 TFLOPs/s。 [5]
